name: Pavement Materials and Systems
description: Pavement structure: functional and structural requirements; pavement materials: aggregate, portland cement, asphalt, Portland cement concrete, asphalt concrete; aggregates: production, properties, characterization procedures, gradation and blending; Portland cement based materials: mixture design, production, properties, testing, construction; asphalt binder: refining process, properties, characterization procedures, viscosity and performance grading systems; asphalt concrete mixture design: fundamentals of mix design procedure, mixture volumetrics, current mix national and international design procedures; production and construction practices; stresses and strains in pavement system: traffic, environment considerations; design of pavements: new, overlay; drainage issues.
